text:
marco_marketing: Heads up we're targeting a benchmark + product blog embargo for Wed May 13 15:00 PT / 22:00 UTC. Need to lock syndication partners and quick localization plan.

nate_pr: Got it. I'll compile the prioritized press list and ping the top 10 for embargo compliance. Any outlets that need an earlier pickup?

anya_local: For translations: we can do JP + ZH-CN in ~5 hours if copy freezes by 02:00 PT. Quick question: will the assets include CSVs or just PNG graphs? CSVs add time for localization notes.

anita_legal: Please send the embargo language ASAP. Legal will run a fast check at T-48h. Also note: avoid absolute superlatives unless we have matchable claims.

marco_marketing: Draft embargo language (short): "Please hold until 2026-05-13 22:00 UTC. Redwood Inference will provide embargoed assets and a spokesperson. Confidentiality appreciated." Thoughts?

nate_pr: Short and fine. Add: contact for scheduling interviews (press@nate). Also offer a 20-min pre-brief if they need.

pressops_bot: Reminder: release-checklist items: legal sign-off, final build link, partner FAQ, tracking params. Use /release-checklist to mark complete.

anya_local: If CSVs are included, we need an extra 2 hours to add localized captions and numeric notes. Recommend PNG-only for initial syndication.

marco_marketing: PNG-only for launch then we'll follow with CSVs in a secondary asset drop. Freeze: 02:00 PT. Syndication window: 22:00-22:30 UTC. EU pre-release only by exception.

anita_legal: Approved pending minor wording tweak. Replace "confidentiality appreciated" with "please maintain embargo until the time listed."

nate_pr: I'll start outreach after legal sign-off. Who is the spokesperson? Carmen or Dev lead? Carmen is preferred for high-level.

marco_marketing: Carmen tentatively. If unavailable Nate + Dev lead can cover. I'll update the release sheet.

pressops_bot: Action summary: [marco_marketing draft partner FAQ], [anya_local localization plan], [nate_pr notify press], [anita_legal final sign-off]. ETA T-48h.

nate_pr: Sending initial DMs now. Will report confirmations in-thread.

marco_marketing: Thanks all. Keep this thread as canonical partner comms thread.
